dedicated.story:
"As sure as I live, I will have my vengeance. Then, I will conquer every inch of the seas my father once ruled over."

On the blizzard-lashed waters of the northeastern seas, Victoria stood upon the deck of a ship, fully exposed to the raging winds whipping around her body as she pulled her pirate hat —a memento of her late father— down firmly over her head. As the hat cast her face in shadow, the lighthearted demeanor of a carefree daughter vanished, replaced by the commanding aura of a sovereign destined to rule the high seas. Victoria fixed her unblinking gaze down into the watery depths of the deep ocean abyss where Iron Devourer lay in wait — and the corners of her mouth curled into a wry smile.

lore:
Victoria is the daughter of a legendary Pirate King. She grew up on his boat, learning how to become a great pirate.
Unfortunately, that led the authorities to place a bounty on the young girl's head, since having her as a hostage would aid them in capturing her father. She had no choice but to learn how to fight in order to protect herself.
Having grown up in a den of pirates as their princess, she learned to make decisions on her feet and developed a knack for aggressively pursuing any chance of turning a profit.
When she became an adult, she left her father's ship and territory behind, acquiring her own ship and becoming a fully-fledged pirate captain in her own right.
She based her new pirate crew out of the Blizzard Sea, which allowed her to easily plunder nearby trade ships running the route between the Mystic Woods, Dark Grave, Dragon Ruins, and the Blizzard Plains.
One day, she heard the news that Iron Devourer had appeared in the Pirate King's territory, sinking half of the ships in his fleet and leading to the Pirate King's death.
She immediately set sail for the northeastern sea and gathered up the remnants of her father's crew. She now controls both her father's territory and her own, and is currently amassing weapons and manpower to get her revenge on Iron Devourer.
